KEY = [0x13, 0x37, 0xC0, 0xDE]
TARGET = [0xcf, 0x2a, 0xcb, 0x84, 0xff, 0x41, 0xef, 0x99, 0x01, 0x57, 0x04, 0xc0, 0x36, 0x7b, 0x1a, 0xcb, 0x2c, 0x80, 0x28, 0xe7, 0x48, 0x9b, 0x3a, 0x21, 0x91, 0xe6, 0xd8, 0xbf, 0xe3, 0x2d]

# Reverse the algorithm
prev = 0x5A
flag_bytes = []

for i in range(len(TARGET)):
    # We had: ((candidate ^ KEY[i%4]) + prev_prev) & 0xFF = target
    # So: candidate = (target - prev_prev) & 0xFF ^ KEY[i%4]
    
    candidate = ((TARGET[i] - prev) & 0xFF) ^ KEY[i % 4]
    flag_bytes.append(candidate)
    prev = TARGET[i]  # prev_prev for next iteration is TARGET[i]
